choices.content: Each trial has only two outcomes, the probability of success is constant, and the trials are independent
Each trial can have many outcomes
The probability of success increases with each trial
The outcomes of the trials must combine in a mutually exclusive way into a single outcome

question.prompt: What conditions must Bernoulli trials satisfy?

solutions.explanation: All three conditions are required: two outcomes, a constant probability, and independence.
solutions.title: Definition of Bernoulli trials
